evals.prompt: distill — 我刚花了两小时排查一个 race condition，最后发现是锁的获取顺序不一致导致的死锁。帮我把这次调试经验提炼出来。
evals.expected_output: Should detect Bug Retrospective scene, produce a document with bug profile, root cause chain with → arrow notation, code evidence (problem + fix), and prevention checklist. Frontmatter in English, body in Chinese. All extraction points have confidence markers.
expectations: Output has YAML frontmatter with `scene: bug-retrospective`
Frontmatter `lang` field is `zh`
Tags include both `distilled` and `scene/bug-retrospective`
Frontmatter `title` is in English (no Chinese characters in title value)
Root Cause Chain uses → arrow notation to show multi-layer causation (surface → direct cause → root cause)
At least 3 extraction points have inline confidence markers (**[high]**, **[medium]**, or **[low]**)
Code Evidence section contains both a problem code block and a fix code block (two distinct fenced code blocks minimum)

evals.prompt: I just finished building a REST API with FastAPI and PostgreSQL. We made some interesting architecture decisions around connection pooling and middleware ordering. Can you extract the key learnings from this session?
evals.expected_output: Should detect Project Wrap-up scene, produce a document with ADRs (alternatives + trade-offs), reusable module table, pitfall guide, and implementation playbook. Frontmatter and body both in English.
expectations: Output has YAML frontmatter with `scene: project-wrapup`
Frontmatter `lang` field is `en`
Tags include at least one of `tech/python`, `tech/fastapi`, or `tech/postgresql`
Frontmatter `title` is in English
Architecture Decisions include 'Alternatives considered' and 'Trade-offs accepted' sub-items for at least one decision
At least 3 extraction points have inline confidence markers (**[high]**, **[medium]**, or **[low]**)
Reusable Modules presented as a table with columns for Module, Purpose, Dependencies, and Adaptation Notes

evals.prompt: retrospective — 今天学了 Rust 的所有权和借用机制，感觉终于理解 borrow checker 了。帮我整理一下。
evals.expected_output: Should detect Tech Learning scene, produce a document with concept map (with associations), API quick-reference table, use-case judgment, and progression roadmap with Level 1/2/3. Frontmatter in English, body in Chinese.
expectations: Output has YAML frontmatter with `scene: tech-learning`
Frontmatter `lang` field is `zh`
Tags include `tech/rust`
Frontmatter `title` is in English (no Chinese characters in title value)
Core Concepts entries include association links ('关联概念', 'Relates to', or similar) connecting concepts to each other
At least 3 extraction points have inline confidence markers (**[high]**, **[medium]**, or **[low]**)
Progression Roadmap has at least 3 distinct levels (Level 1/2/3 or equivalent tiered structure)
